nodes.Έλεγχος Ρομποτικού Βραχίονα μέσω Brain–C: Robotic Arm Control through a Brain–Computer Interface Using EEG Motor Imagery
nodes.Robotic Arm Control through a Brain–Comp: Diploma thesis · Greek title: Έλεγχος Ρομποτικού Βραχίονα μέσω Brain–Computer Interface με χρήση EEG και Νοερών Κινήσεων
nodes.Όταν κλείνεις νοερά το χέρι σου χωρίς να: When you imagine closing your hand without moving it, the sensorimotor cortex reacts almost as it does in real movement. The question here is how far that trace reaches.
nodes.Το ζητούμενο δεν ήταν ένα εντυπωσιακό βί: The aim was not an impressive video. It was to measure, under the strictest evaluation scheme the data allow, how reliably this chain works on people who have never used a brain–computer interface. The answer is that it works, but not for everyone, and the difference between the two ways of measuring turned out to be the most interesting finding of the work.
nodes.Έξι στάδια χωρίζουν έναν εγκεφαλικό ρυθμ: Six stages separate a brain rhythm from the rotation of a servo. Red markers mean hardware, blue means software.
nodes.Οκτώ ηλεκτρόδια στην κεντρική και κεντρο: Eight electrodes over the central and fronto-central strip in the 10–20 system, with an ADS1299 amplifier and markers synchronised through Lab Streaming Layer.
nodes.1–40 Hz FIR · notch 50 Hz · CAR · κατώφλ: 1–40 Hz FIR · 50 Hz notch · CAR · 200 µV threshold
nodes.Το CSP βρίσκει τους χωρικούς συνδυασμούς: CSP finds the spatial combinations of channels that maximise the difference in power between the two classes. Ledoit-Wolf regularisation keeps it stable with so few channels.
nodes.Τέσσερις ταξινομητές αξιολογήθηκαν συγκρ: Four classifiers were compared and performed essentially the same. Fisher's linear discriminant is the one used in the demo, as the simplest of them.
nodes.LDA · SVM-RBF · SVM γραμμικό · Riemannia: LDA · SVM-RBF · linear SVM · Riemannian MDM
nodes.Δύο εντολές ταξιδεύουν στη σειριακή θύρα: Two commands travel over the serial port. The PCA9685 driver turns the decision into pulses for five servos, which pull the finger tendons.
nodes.9600 baud · I²C · min = κλείσιμο · mid =: 9600 baud · I²C · min = close · mid = open
nodes.Ο marker καταγράφεται τη στιγμή που η οδ: The marker is recorded the moment the cue disappears and only the fixation cross is left. The beep half a second earlier prepares the participant without having time to contaminate the analysis window. The random rest interval keeps the brain from predicting when the next cue arrives.
nodes.Πάνω από τον κινητικό φλοιό κάθε ημισφαι: Over the motor cortex of each hemisphere. This is where ERD shows up most clearly.
nodes.Πλαισιώνουν την κεντρική ζώνη και δίνουν: They frame the central strip and give CSP spatial information.
nodes.Οι δοκιμές των δύο κλάσεων εναλλάσσονται: The trials of the two classes alternate in random order within each run, so that neither the participant nor the classifier can lean on a pattern. A mandatory break separates the runs.
nodes.Το φαινόμενο που ψάχνουμε: The phenomenon we are looking for
nodes.Η πτώση αυτή ονομάζεται αποσυγχρονισμός: That drop is called event-related desynchronisation and it is the signal the whole chain is looking for. The chart alongside shows the average of all 320 trials of participant S11: power in the 8–13 Hz band, as a percentage change from the second before the marker.
nodes.Η γραμμή βάσης εδώ δεν είναι χαλαρή ανάπ: The baseline here is not relaxed rest: at that moment the cue is still on screen and the participant is alert, so the mu rhythm is already suppressed in both classes. What follows the marker is their difference. In rest trials the rhythm recovers and rises twenty points above the baseline. In motor imagery trials it stays pinned to the baseline for all four seconds.
nodes.Αυτή ακριβώς η απόσταση ανάμεσα στις δύο: It is exactly this distance between the two curves, around twenty percentage points on both channels, that the classifier tries to exploit. In the single trial, though, where it actually has to work, the signal is far noisier than in the average.
nodes.Μέση ισχύς 8–13 Hz ως ποσοστιαία μεταβολ: Mean 8–13 Hz power as a percentage change from the second before the marker, while the cue was still on screen. Average of 160 trials per class.
nodes.Πραγματικές δοκιμές, πραγματικός ταξινομ: Real trials, a real classifier, a hand in three dimensions. The classifier was trained on runs 1–3 and here it sees run 4 for the first time.
nodes.Κάθε δοκιμή που παίζει είναι καταγεγραμμ: Every trial that plays is recorded signal from disk, not a simulation. The waveforms are channels C3 and C4 after 1–40 Hz filtering and a common average reference. The decision appears at 3.5 seconds, as soon as the classification window closes, and that is exactly when the command leaves for the hand.
nodes.Οι κυματομορφές των συμμετεχόντων δεν δη: Participant waveforms are not published in this version. The EEG was collected with informed consent for the study and is personal data.
nodes.Η ανάλυση που προκύπτει από αυτές παραμέ: The analysis that comes out of them stays here: the ERD curves in section 04 and the results for all 14 participants in section 06. The hand alongside opens and closes from the buttons.
nodes.Στη ζωντανή επίδειξη ο ταξινομητής εκπαι:
In the live demo the classifier trains on runs 1–3 and decides on run 4:
S11 72.5% · S01 60.0% · S02 48.1%
nodes.Περιστροφή με σύρσιμο · άνοιγμα και κλεί: Drag to rotate · open and close from the buttons
nodes.Η ζωντανή κάμερα ζητά άδεια από τον περι: The live camera asks the browser for permission and sends the image nowhere: the stream stays inside the page, on the computer doing the presenting. It needs a page on https or localhost. During the presentation the physical hand is driven by replay_demo.py over the serial port, while the camera shows it here.
nodes.Δύο σχήματα αξιολόγησης δίνουν δύο διαφο: Two evaluation schemes give two different answers for the same dataset. Their difference is the main finding of the work.
nodes.Το <strong>10-fold cross-validation</str: 10-fold cross-validation shuffles all the trials and keeps a tenth for testing. But because trials from the same run resemble each other, the classifier has already seen every run during training. The number that comes out is optimistic.
nodes.Το <strong>Leave-One-Run-Out</strong> κρ: Leave-One-Run-Out keeps a whole run out of training. It is the scheme that corresponds to real use, where the user puts on the headset and the system is asked to work on fresh signal.
nodes.Πόσο κοστίζει το αυστηρό σχήμα αξιολόγησ: What the strict evaluation scheme costs
nodes.Ακρίβεια ανά συμμετέχοντα με τα δύο σχήμ: Accuracy per participant under the two schemes. The line shows the distance between them.
nodes.Η ετυμηγορία είναι επιτυχία όταν ο έλεγχ: The verdict is a pass when a permutation test with 1,000 repetitions gives p<0.05 and accuracy at the same time exceeds 60% with κ>0.2. A failure means decoding does not stand apart from chance. κ is Cohen's coefficient, which corrects for agreement that would arise by chance.
nodes.Το ποσοστό εποχών που επιβιώνουν από την: The share of epochs surviving artifact rejection looked excellent almost everywhere. It turned out to hide the problem rather than show it.
nodes.Ο λόγος είναι η σειρά των πράξεων. Η από: The reason is the order of operations. Rejection is applied after the band-pass filter and the common average reference, which have already removed the large DC offsets. A channel with poor contact sails through the check.
nodes.Προστέθηκαν δύο έλεγχοι που τρέχουν στο: Two checks were added that run on the raw signal, before any filter: the share of samples that hit the converter's rail, and chronic one-sided offset, meaning channels stuck at one sign for the entire session.
nodes.Το εύρημα οδήγησε σε αλλαγή στο ίδιο το: The finding led to a change in the recording software itself. The check now runs automatically right after the baseline recording and warns the experimenter to look again at the contact of the reference electrode, before a whole hour-long session is lost.
nodes.Τι έδειξε ο έλεγχος στο ακατέργαστο σήμα: What the check on the raw signal showed
nodes.Και οι 14 συνεδρίες περνούν τον έλεγχο φ: All 14 sessions pass the physiological spectrum check after filtering. The flags concern the quality of the recording, not whether the signal is recoverable.
nodes.S04, S07, S08, S10, S12, S13 — τουλάχιστ: S04, S07, S08, S10, S12, S13 — at least six of the eight channels stuck at one sign for the whole session. The likeliest cause is the contact of the reference electrode.
nodes.S01 στο 6,0% των δειγμάτων, S03 στο 3,4%: S01 on 6.0% of samples, S03 on 3.4%, S14 on 2.7%, S06 on 2.4%, S09 on 1.9%, S05 on 1.5%. Characteristic of intermittent movement artifacts.
nodes.S02 και S11 — καμία από τις δύο σημάνσει: S02 and S11 — neither of the two flags.
nodes.Η σήμανση δεν προδικάζει την απόδοση: A flag does not decide performance
nodes.Οι S12 και S13 φέρουν μονόπλευρο offset: S12 and S13 carry a one-sided offset and pass LORO nonetheless. S02 is one of the two cleanest recordings and fails below chance level. The two checks answer different questions and have to be presented together.
nodes.Το χέρι τυπώθηκε και συναρμολογήθηκε από: The hand was printed and assembled from scratch. Its mechanics are the reason the three-dimensional model above moves the way it does.
nodes.Η παλάμη πριν από το κάλυμμα. Κάθε δάχτυ: The palm before the cover. Each finger is pulled by a cord that runs through channels on the dorsal side and ends up in the forearm.
nodes.Ο πήχης ανοιχτός. Πέντε σερβοκινητήρες,: The forearm opened. Five servos, one per finger, wind the cord and pull it. The return is done by springs at the joints.
nodes.Πέντε σερβοκινητήρες στον πήχη, ένας ανά: Five servos in the forearm, one per finger, cord-driven against return springs.
nodes.Arduino με οδηγό PCA9685 μέσω I²C. Ομαλή: Arduino with a PCA9685 driver over I²C. Smooth position transitions, so that closing is not abrupt.
nodes.Σειριακή στα 9600 baud. Η εντολή <code>m: Serial at 9600 baud. The min command closes the hand, mid opens it.
nodes.Η οδήγηση με κορδόνι σημαίνει ότι ο κινη: Cord drive means the motor can only pull. Opening is left to the springs, which is why it is always a little slower than closing, something the three-dimensional model shows as well.
nodes.Το ίδιο σκεπτικό εξηγεί γιατί η εντολή ε: The same reasoning explains why the command is binary. With eight channels and two classes, the realistic goal is a reliable distinction between two states, not independent control of five fingers.
nodes.Πέντε στους δεκατέσσερις δεν αποκωδικοπο: Five in fourteen do not decode at all
nodes.Ποσοστό 36%, πάνω από το 15 έως 30% που: That is 36%, above the 15 to 30% the literature reports for brain–computer interface illiteracy. With a single session per participant and no familiarisation with the protocol, the difference is expected, but it has to be stated.
nodes.Η απόδοση πέφτει μέσα στην ίδια τη συνεδ: Performance falls within the session itself
nodes.Εννιά από τους δεκατέσσερις δείχνουν φθί: Nine of the fourteen show a declining trend from the first run to the fourth, even those who pass overall. An hour of concentrated motor imagery is tiring, and that is measurable.
nodes.Η ποιότητα καταγραφής χρειάζεται δικό τη: Recording quality needs a check of its own
nodes.Το ποσοστό επιβίωσης εποχών δεν αρκεί. Ο: The epoch survival rate is not enough. The check has to be made on the raw signal and before the session starts, not in the analysis afterwards.

nodes.Παναγιώτης Λεβεντογιάννης · Επιβλέπων: Α: Panagiotis Leventogiannis · Supervisor: Athanasios Koutras, Associate Professor
nodes.Τμήμα Ηλεκτρολόγων Μηχανικών και Μηχανικ: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering · University of the Peloponnese · Patras 2026
nodes.Το ολοκληρωμένο ρομποτικό χέρι InMoov i2: The completed InMoov i2 robotic hand with its forearm, printed in black PLA, with red tendons and servo wiring.
nodes.Ο σκελετός της παλάμης τυπωμένος σε μαύρ: The palm frame printed in black PLA, with the red tendon cords threaded through the palm channels towards the fingers.
nodes.Ο πήχης ανοιχτός, με τη συστοιχία σερβοκ: The forearm opened, with the bank of servos inside and the signal and power wires coming out of the opening.
nodes.Χρονοδιάγραμμα μιας δοκιμής: ηρεμία 1,5: Timeline of a trial: rest 1.5 to 2.5 seconds, preparation 2 seconds, cue 2.25 seconds, motor imagery 4 seconds with the marker at its start, break 1.5 seconds.
nodes.Διάταξη ηλεκτροδίων: C3 και C4 εκατέρωθε: Electrode layout: C3 and C4 on either side of Cz, with FC3, FCz, FC4 in front and CP3, CP4 behind.
nodes.Το μοντέλο παραπάνω δείχνει την απόφαση: The model above shows what the classifier decides. Here is the same thing on the physical hand, filmed while the classifier was giving the commands.

The model above shows what the classifier decides. Here is the same thing on the physical hand: the video of the demo, and the live camera for the presentation itself, so that the hand is on the same screen as the data.
nodes.Το χέρι InMoov i2 όπως κατασκευάστηκε: κ: The InMoov i2 hand as built: three printed segments per finger, two on the thumb, with red tendon cords running back to the five servos inside the forearm.
nodes.Η νοερή κίνηση του δεξιού χεριού αποδυνα: Imagining a movement of the right hand weakens the mu rhythm over the opposite hemisphere. The phenomenon is called event-related desynchronisation.
nodes.Ζωνοπερατό φίλτρο, αποκοπή των 50 Hz του: A band-pass filter, a notch at the 50 Hz mains, a common average reference to take out whatever is shared across all channels, and rejection of epochs with extreme amplitudes.
nodes.Στη ζωντανή λειτουργία το παράθυρο ανάλυ: In live operation the one-second analysis window slides every 125 ms, and a command only leaves when at least five of the last seven decisions agree. Counting the time the window needs to fill with fresh signal, that puts roughly one to one and a half seconds between the change of state and the movement.
nodes.Μεσαία γραμμή, χωρίς δική τους πλευρά. Μ: Midline, with no side of their own. They go into the common average like every other channel.
nodes.Ο ρυθμός μ, γύρω στα 10 Hz, είναι ο ρυθμ: The mu rhythm, around 10 Hz, is the resting rhythm of the motor cortex. The moment the cortex engages, even in imagination alone, the rhythm breaks.
nodes.InMoov i2, τρισδιάστατη εκτύπωση σε μαύρ: InMoov i2, 3D printed in black PLA. Three segments per finger, two on the thumb.
nodes.Το τρισδιάστατο μοντέλο αναπαράγει τη γε: The three-dimensional model reproduces the geometry of the hand as it was built: three segments per finger, two on the thumb, return springs at the joints, and tendons that run through the palm towards the forearm. When the classifier decides motor imagery, the tendons pull and the hand closes, exactly as the physical hand does when it receives the min command. The servo sound is generated by the page at the moment of motion and lasts as long as the travel: shorter on closing, which the motor pulls, slower on opening, which the springs return.
nodes.Με το συνηθισμένο 10-fold cross-validati: With the usual 10-fold cross-validation almost every participant looked successful. But when the classifier is trained on three runs and tested on a fourth it has never seen (leave-one-run-out, with a permutation test), only 6 of 14 truly generalize. That gap between the lab and real use is the question I want to keep working on.
nodes.Κάθε συμμετέχων πέρασε τέσσερα runs των: Every participant went through four runs of eighty trials, alternating motor imagery and rest, following the Graz-BCI protocol.
nodes.14 συμμετέχοντες × 4 runs × 80 δοκιμές =: 14 participants × 4 runs × 80 trials = 4,480 trials in total, split evenly between motor imagery and rest. Every session began with a baseline recording, eyes open and eyes closed, so that contact quality could be checked before the runs started.
nodes.Η εργασία κατασκευάζει ολόκληρη την αλυσ: This work builds the entire chain, from the scalp to the fingers: eight electrodes over the central strip, a classifier that learns to tell motor imagery from rest, and an InMoov i2 robotic hand that opens and closes according to its decision. Every component is open source and low cost, under €1,500 in hardware altogether.
nodes.Η αλυσίδα δουλεύει με υλικό κάτω από 1.5: The chain works with hardware under €1,500
nodes.Σε δεδομένα που ο ταξινομητής δεν είχε ξ: On data the classifier had never seen, the system carried out 72.5% of the commands correctly for the best participant. The effect is statistically significant at group level even under the strict evaluation scheme. Research systems normally used for the same job cost more than €20,000.
nodes.Ο S02 βγάζει 55,5% με 10-fold και 46,7%: S02 scores 55.5% with 10-fold and 46.7% with LORO, below chance. Its model simply predicts rest almost always: the F1 score is 0.28 for motor imagery against 0.58 for rest. Shuffling the trials hid this failure to generalise completely.
nodes.Με τον ίδιο ταξινομητή και στα δύο σχήμα: With the same classifier under both schemes, moving from the first to the second costs 1.7 points of accuracy on average, but the damage is not shared equally: for some participants it is negligible, for others decoding collapses entirely.
nodes.Και τα δύο σχήματα ξεπερνούν το επίπεδο: Both schemes exceed chance level with statistical significance, by a one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test over the 14 participants: 10-fold W=104, p<0.001 · LORO W=94, p=0.003. The effect is therefore real even under the strict scheme.
nodes.σωστές εντολές σε run εκτός εκπαίδευσης: commands correct on a held-out run (S11)
nodes.Η αξιολόγηση είναι εκτός σύνδεσης: οι δο: The evaluation is offline: the trials are replayed from disk and not from a live headset, so the effect of feedback on the user is not measured. Eight channels are the minimum for CSP and limit spatial resolution. Every participant gave a single session, with no room for learning, and the stability of the model from day to day was not evaluated. Six of the fourteen are left-handed but everyone imagined moving the right hand, so the assumption that ERD shows up over C3 holds less firmly for them.
nodes.14 υγιείς εθελοντές, 19–27 ετών (6 άνδρε: 14 healthy volunteers, aged 19–27 (6 men, 8 women; 8 right-handed, 6 left-handed). 13 of the 14 had never used a brain–computer interface before. Everyone imagined moving the right hand, whichever hand they use. Recordings took place in May–June 2026, one session each, with written informed consent.
nodes.Με 10-fold οι τέσσερις ταξινομητές δίνου: Under 10-fold the four classifiers give almost the same result: LDA 60.8%, linear SVM 61.1%, RBF SVM 60.5%, Riemannian MDM 60.5%. So the comparison here uses the linear discriminant under both schemes.
nodes.Το 72,5% της επίδειξης είναι ένα μόνο fo: The 72.5% in the demo is a single fold: trained on runs 1–3 and tested on run 4, with 58 of 80 commands correct. The LORO column is the mean over all four folds, which is why S11 shows 74.7% there.
nodes.Δικός μου κώδικας σε Python: το παράδειγ: My own Python code: the recording paradigm in pygame with markers over Lab Streaming Layer, the link to the Cyton through BrainFlow, preprocessing in MNE-Python, CSP and the classifiers in scikit-learn and pyRiemann, and Arduino firmware for the servos.
nodes.Το κενό ανάμεσα στο 10-fold και το LORO: The gap between 10-fold and LORO is what I want to keep working on. LORO measured it within a single session. The next steps are to measure it, and close it, across days, across people and in real use.
nodes.Riemannian ή Euclidean alignment ώστε έν: Riemannian or Euclidean alignment, so that a model carries over to a new session or a new user without recalibration, always evaluated on data it has not seen.
nodes.Online λειτουργία όπου ο χρήστης βλέπει: Online operation where the user sees the hand respond, with a classifier that adapts during use. That is where it gets decided whether the five who failed can learn.
nodes.Για να ξεχωρίσει η πραγματική αδυναμία χ: To separate real BCI inefficiency from plain lack of practice, and to measure how stable the model is over time.
nodes.Μοντέλα που μαθαίνουν τα χαρακτηριστικά: Models that learn their own features
nodes.EEGNet και ShallowConvNet απέναντι στο C: EEGNet and ShallowConvNet against CSP with a linear discriminant, under the same strict LORO evaluation.
nodes.Υβριδικά συστήματα που συνδυάζουν νοερή: Hybrid systems that combine motor imagery with SSVEP or P300, evaluation with people with motor impairments, and a portable version with on-board processing.
nodes.Η διπλωματική είναι γραμμένη στα ελληνικ: The thesis is written in Greek and opens with an English abstract. This page is its fuller summary in English. The code, from recording to the hand's firmware, is open under the MIT licence.
nodes.Ευχαριστώ τον επιβλέποντά μου, Αθανάσιο: Thanks to my supervisor, Athanasios Koutras, for his guidance and trust, and to the friends who wore the electrode cap and gave an hour of motor imagery each so that this data could exist.
nodes.8 κανάλια στα 250 Hz. Εδώ τρέχει ο έλεγχ: 8 channels at 250 Hz. The quality check from section 07 runs here, before any filter.
nodes.Κόβει την αργή μετατόπιση και τον θόρυβο: Removes slow drift and muscle noise.
Removes the hum of the mains.
nodes.Αφαιρεί από κάθε κανάλι ό,τι είναι κοινό: Subtracts from each channel whatever all channels share.
nodes.Κομμάτια γύρω από κάθε δοκιμή. Όσα ξεπερ: Segments around each trial. Any that exceed 200 µV are rejected.
nodes.Μένουν οι ρυθμοί μ και β, εκεί που φαίνε: Only the mu and beta rhythms remain, where ERD shows.
nodes.Τέσσερα χωρικά φίλτρα. Από κάθε δοκιμή μ: Four spatial filters. Each trial is reduced to four power values.
nodes.Η εντολή φεύγει μόνο αν συμφωνούν οι 5 α: A command is sent only if 5 of the last 7 decisions agree.
nodes.Ο καθαρισμός και η απόφαση, βήμα βήμα: Cleaning and decision, step by step
nodes.Δύο τρόποι να χωρίσεις τα ίδια δεδομένα: Two ways to split the same data
nodes.Κάθε τετράγωνο είναι τέσσερις δοκιμές εν: Each square is four trials of one participant. Grey: training. Red: test.
nodes.Οι δοκιμές ανακατεύονται. Το κομμάτι ελέ: Trials are shuffled. The test part comes from every run, so the classifier has already seen each run.
nodes.Ένα ολόκληρο run μένει έξω και ο ταξινομ: A whole run is held out and the classifier is judged on a recording it has never seen, as in real use. Repeated four times, once per run.
nodes.Τι παθαίνει το σήμα από τη στιγμή που φε: What happens to the signal from the moment it leaves the scalp until it becomes a command to the hand. Steps 1 to 5 clean the signal, in the order they are applied.
nodes.Όταν φαντάζεσαι μια κίνηση του δεξιού χε: When you imagine moving your right hand without moving it, the mu rhythm (8–13 Hz) over the left motor cortex weakens. This is called event-related desynchronisation (ERD), and it is the signal the whole system looks for.
nodes.Οκτώ ηλεκτρόδια πάνω από τον κινητικό φλ: Eight electrodes over the motor cortex record the signal with an OpenBCI Cyton. Every on-screen cue is time-stamped through Lab Streaming Layer, so we know what was asked at each moment.
nodes.Το σήμα καθαρίζεται από θόρυβο, το CSP β: The signal is cleaned of noise, CSP finds the channel combinations that best separate the two states, and a linear classifier decides: motor imagery or rest. Step by step in detail below.
nodes.Η απόφαση φεύγει από τη σειριακή θύρα. Έ: The decision goes out over the serial port. An Arduino with a PCA9685 driver moves five servos that pull the tendons: motor imagery closes the hand, rest opens it.
nodes.Ο συμμετέχων δεν κουνάει το χέρι του, απ: The participant does not move their hand; they only imagine closing it. That leaves a small but measurable trace in the EEG. The system detects it and turns it into a command for the robotic hand, in four steps.
nodes.Από μέσα: ο καθαρισμός και η απόφαση, βή: Inside step 3: cleaning and decision, step by step
The system works with hardware under €1,500
